text.en:
Reconstitution. - The Bipartisan Executive-Legislative
Advisory Council, hereinafter referred to as the Council, is hereby
reconstituted and shall be composed of the following:
Five (5) representatives from the Executive Branch to be
designated by the President of the Republic of the Philippines;
Five (5) members of the Senate which shall include a member
from the minority party, to be designated by the Senate
c. Five (5) members of the House of Representatives which shall
include a member from the minority party, to be designated by
the Speaker of the House of Representatives; and
Three (3) representatives from the private sector, to be
appointed by the President of the Republic of the Philippines.
The President shall designate the Chairman of the Council.

Functions. - The Council shall serve as an advisory
body to the President with respect to the broad range of issues
concerning Sabah.

Meetings. - The President shall call the initial
meeting of the Council, as reconstituted. Thereafter, the Council shall
meet as often as agreed upon by the body or as may be convened by the

Secretariat.
- The Council shall reorganize its
Secretariat to be headed by an Executive Director who shall be the
current Head of the Sabah Office of the Department of Foreign Affairs

Office. - The Council shall hold office at the DFA
which shall ensure that the Council is provided with the necessary office
space and facilities.

Funding. - Appropriations for the operations and
activities of the Council shall continue to be incorporated in the budget
proposals under the DA.

Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately upon approval.
City of Manila, September 6, 2002.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
